name: 관계절 - PART 3 - 미국에 사는 친구 / 수영장이 있는 호텔 / 개봉하지 않은 영화

keywords.ko: 미국에 사는(살고 있는) 친구한테 들었어요.(들은 얘기예요)

keywords.en: I heard it  from a friend + who lives in the US( who is living in the U.S)
I  have a friend + that friend is a doctor
→ I have a friend who is a doctor.

keywords.ko: 저희는 정말 좋은 수영장이 있는 호텔에서 묵었어요.

keywords.en: We stayed at a hotel + that hotel had a really good swimming pool.
→ We stayed at a hotel that had a really good swimming pool.
keywords.ko: 어제, 한국에는 아직 개봉하지 않은 영화를 봤어요.

keywords.en: Yesterday I saw a movie + that movie isn’t released yet in Korea.
→ Yesterday I saw a movie that isn’t released yet in Korea.
release → be released (the movie is release)
I want to buy some T shirts + those T-shirts don’t have any pictures or writing.
keywords.ko: 아무런 그림이나 문구가 없는 티셔츠를 좀 사고 싶어요

keywords.en: → I want to buy some T-shirts that don’t have any pictures or writing on them

keywords.ko: 저희는 정말 좋은 수영장이 있는 호텔에서 묵었어요.
어제, 한국에는 아직 개봉하지 않은 영화를 봤어요.

keywords.en: I heard it from a friend who lives(is living) in the US
keywords.ko: 아무런 그림이나 문가가 없는 티셔츠를 좀 사고 싶어요.

keywords.en: I have a friend who is a doctor
We stayed at a hotel that had a really nice swimming pool.
Yesterday, I saw a movie that isn’t released yet in Korea.
(Yesterday, I saw a movie that hasn’t been released yet in Korea.)
I want to buy some T shirts that don’t have any pictures
